ITEM 1 | Dark reddish-brown to near-black small oval fruits, glossy smooth skin with slight wrinkling, whole and uncut, about 1.5–2 cm long, scattered across the center and right side of the bowl, some partly hidden under greens; firm and plump, no visible juice | 55
ITEM 2 | Mixed loose salad leaves in varying greens: pale lime-green smooth oval leaves with prominent central veins, darker green frilly curly-edged leaves, and some small pale yellow-green crinkled leaves, fresh and slightly glossy, spread across most of the bowl, roughly 5–12 cm per leaf | 70
ITEM 3 | Thin pinkish-red stem or stalk, smooth and slightly translucent, about 6 cm long, curved across the lower left of the salad | 3
ITEM 4 | Dark purplish-brown wilted leaf fragment with ruffled edges, matte and slightly limp, about 4 cm across, at the lower right edge of the greens | 4
